why: Every route file in app/, opened cold by its deep link in the route walk (WORKLIST P0.86): its link, with a {placeholder} for each id the sealed world's seed made, read back from its database when the walk runs. routes.test.ts holds this list to the route files: a new route fails until it is here. Run as the seeded member unless `as` says otherwise. Then the moments, as the member: each a screen past its link, reached by its taps in order (a control's id, or the words it shows or is labelled), with what shows once it is there, captured as the routes are (a system alert, the keyboard and the calendar, which the dark walk holds to the plain one; WORKLIST P0.86). routes.test.ts holds each tap to something the app draws.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx.why: a launch at / reopens the tab the member was on within the half hour (src/utils/lastTab.ts), so the walk reaches the Lobby by its tab, as a member does (run 39021476421 landed on the profile)

app/lounge.tsx.why: the alias that redirects to the tab: one link, opened once as the tab's

app/(modals)/social-modal.tsx.why: a link that names nothing to show closes the modal (resolveMode: not valid; run 39566918888 saw it close), so the walk opens it as a person's page does, to share the person

app/(admin)/tribunal.tsx.why: as the member: the admin layout sends one who is no admin to the profile; the admin's own room is P0.86's admin pass

app/auth-callback.tsx.why: with no link's tokens: its own say that the link is spent

app/reset-password.tsx.why: with no recovery session: its own say

app/dossier/[id].tsx.why: the old dossier link forwards to the Dispatch reader, which reads every kind of filing

the sign-out alert.why: A system alert the app raises (Alert.alert): Android draws it, in the theme the app sets, so the dark walk holds it to the plain walk's, whose system is light. Nothing is signed out: the walk stops the app on the alert. Opened at the settings' import section, a few screens above SIGN OUT: from the top, the dark walk ran out of its minute to scroll there (39642887150).

the keyboard.why: The keyboard over the app: Android's keyboard follows the system's mode (keyboardAppearance is iOS's alone), so the keyboard is the system's to draw and the screen above it the app's. The flows run with no keyboard; it is on for this moment alone.

the calendar.why: The date picker a log is filed by: the app's own calendar (src/components/NitrateCalendar.tsx), never a native picker, so it must look the same whatever the system's mode.
